{{Quote|We are a division of the Imperial Navy, but no record in the Imperial Archive on Coruscant would indicate our existence. We serve the will of the Emperor directly and silently. '''Hakasha Sireen''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who operated as an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE pilot|pilot]] trainer for [[Black Epsilon]] out of the [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] [[Talus Imperial Outpost|Imperial Outpost]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
